message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after an earlier missile commitment by maintaining a fast, level eastward extension rather than turning toward the southbound opponents; its missile remained active to the north while an opposing missile closed from that quarter, and speed steadily increased without sacrificing altitude.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the missile exchange by diving and making a sustained right turn into a southeastward extension, building speed and lateral separation as a B-launched missile closed from the north; it continued the extension after B0200 became inactive instead of redirecting toward B0100."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after an earlier missile commitment by maintaining a fast, level eastward extension rather than turning toward the southbound opponents; its missile remained active to the north while an opposing missile closed from that quarter, and speed steadily increased without sacrificing altitude.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive the missile exchange by diving and making a sustained right turn into a southeastward extension, building speed and lateral separation as a B-launched missile closed from the north; it continued the extension after B0200 became inactive instead of redirecting toward B0100.
